description:
A former customer, Sarah Connor (sarah.connor.privacy@example.com), has submitted a formal GDPR request to have all her personal data erased. 

1. Configure WooCommerce's Accounts & Privacy settings to ensure that personal data is removed from orders when an erasure request is processed (this is NOT enabled by default).
2. Use the 'Erase Personal Data' tool in WordPress to process the request for 'sarah.connor.privacy@example.com'.
3. Ensure the request is fully processed (Force Erase if necessary) so the user is deleted and their past order data is anonymized.
